focus.substep: Find what opens alchemy.xml in the recompiled code, and why that path is never reached
focus.why: The retail game, traced in Cemu, opens alchemy.xml first and then permanent/bootstrap.bld. Ours opens no file at all. Every step around the failure has now been measured as working, so the fault is upstream of all of them.
